# Fixtures

`home/` is a minimal argani home with two registered projects: `demo` with four tasks, and `other` with one task (`write-docs`, a draft intent in Backlog), so project filtering is observable. In `demo`: `add-login` has only a draft intent (Backlog), `fix-export` has an approved intent and spec but no build yet (In progress), and `pick-database` has a draft intent with a `## Questions for human` section and a `history.jsonl` (Needs human, two visits, one manual acceptance criterion), and `ship-report` went through build, review and decision and has an `mr.md` with an `MR: https://example.com/demo/merge_requests/1` line and a `Merged:` line (Done). Project `demo` has two reviewers (`code`, `docs`); `ship-report` has two review rounds: round 1 has `code` CHANGES and `docs` PASS, `build.md` has the rework heading, and round 2 has both PASS (each round also has a `change.diff`). Event files are date-named, so tests write them for today's date at run time instead of committing them.
